text: Special Ammo Synthesis is a consumable item that provides a one-time refill of a Guardian's Special Weapon ammunition. Like other consumables, Special Ammo Synthesis can be used only once, but players can carry multiples in their inventory. There is a maximum of 100 in one stack. There is a five minute cooldown for all ammo synthesis items after using one.
Sojourn is a legendary Dead Orbit Hunter armor set. The set can be purchased from Arach Jalaal.
Sinaa Jaguar 2.1 is an uncommon Hunter chest armor manufactured by the Vanguard, and is part of the Sinaa Jaguar 2.1 armor set.
Shingen-E is a rare auto rifle. It can be obtained from engrams or purchased from Banshee-44.

A ship schematic could be brought to Amanda Holliday in the Tower to be exchanged for a random jumpship. Ship schematics could be obtained randomly from Loot Chests, completing Crucible matches, and turning in bounties. In Destiny: The Taken King, Amanda Holliday began selling these jumpships directly, and the blueprints were made unobtainable.

Shattered Memory Fragment is an exotic weapon bounty that ultimately rewarded the exotic fusion rifle Pocket Infinity. The bounty could be obtained from the Vanguard Mentor Missive, but was made unavailable in The Taken King.
Skull of Dire Ahamkara is an exotic Warlock helmet. It can be obtained through random loot drops or purchased from Xûr.
The Slap Rifle is a weapon commonly used by most Vex Goblins. It fires Solar bolts.
Shadow Price is a legendary Vanguard auto rifle. It can be obtained by decrypting engrams or from ranking up Vanguard reputation.
Silimar's Wrath is a Legendary auto rifle. It can be purchased from Lord Saladin for 11,500 Glimmer once Iron Banner rank 5 is attained.
Skorri's Revenge is legendary pulse rifle obtained as a completion reward from the Iron Banner Crucible event.

Sniper Rifle Telemetry is a consumable that increases the experience gained towards sniper rifles for 30 minutes. Prior to Destiny: The Taken King, they could be purchased from Xûr or from dismantling upgraded legendary sniper rifles. After The Taken King, they were replaced by Special Telemetry.
Shin Malphur was the last known carrier of The Last Word, and the killer of Dredgen Yor. He is also known by Dredgen Vale, an identity he used to found the Shadows of Yor.

The Shrapnel Launcher is a weapon used by Eliksni Captains and Marauders as well as high-ranking Dregs that fires four shrapnel projectiles like a shotgun. It causes Solar damage. Guardians have access to an Exotic Shrapnel Launcher called Lord of Wolves. It functions similarly to the Shrapnel Launcher wielded by Fallen, except it fires a rapid 5-round burst instead of a slower 4-round burst.
A Shock Rifle is a weapon used by Eliksni Vandals and Captains. To fire, they must be charged beforehand. They fire three slow, homing bolts of blue energy. They deal Arc damage.

A Shock Dagger is a melee weapon used by Eliksni Dregs. They appear similar to normal blades except with a slight blue glow around them. Dregs will viciously slash at Guardians with these if they are close. They cause Arc damage.

A Shock Blade is a melee weapon used by Eliksni Captains, Vandals, and Marauders. Similar to the Shock Dagger, albeit much larger, they resemble cutlasses with a blue glow towards the tip. They cause Arc damage.
Silvered Maverick Mk. 41 is a rare hand cannon that can be earned through a loot drop at the end of a Crucible match.

A Shock Grenade is a weapon used by Eliksni Dregs. When thrown, they can stick to any surface. After a couple of seconds, the grenade detonates, dealing Arc damage to a small area.

Spinmetal is a material that is used to upgrade legendary and exotic weapons and armor. Spinmetal can be harvested from Spinmetal Leaves, which appear randomly in some areas on Earth. Spinmetal may also be awarded to players for opening loot chests on Earth, completing Daily Heroic Story Missions, turning in Patrol or Queen's Wrath bounties, or opening Judgment's Grant packages. They can be purchased from the Vanguard Quartermaster for Legendary Marks at a rate of 10 Marks for 20 Spinmetal. Once obtained, Spinmetal is stored in a player's inventory. 200 Spinmetal can be stored in a single stack, after which point a new stack is started.

Spirit Bloom is a material that is used to upgrade legendary and exotic weapons and armor. Spirit Bloom can be harvested from some areas on Venus. Spirit Blooms may also be awarded to players for opening loot chests on Venus, completing Daily Heroic Story Missions, turning in Patrol or Queen's Wrath bounties, or opening Judgment's Grant packages. They can be purchased from the Vanguard Quartermaster for Legendary Marks at the rate of 10 marks for 20 Spirit Blooms. Once obtained, Spirit Bloom is stored in a player's inventory. 200 Spirit Bloom can be stored in a single stack, after which point a new stack is started.

A subclass attribute in Destiny is an attribute that is dependent on a Guardian's subclass. The subclass attributes are Armor, Recovery, and Agility. Each class receives a bonus to a particular attribute. At level 1, Hunters have 1 Armor, 1 Recovery, and 5 Agility; Titans have 5 Armor, 1 Recovery, and 1 Agility; and Warlocks have 1 Armor, 5 Recovery, and 1 Agility.
